user_prompt: Given this ClinicalTrials.gov study record (NCT03898180), is this a completed, adequately-powered Phase 3 interventional trial sponsored by Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC?
scope: The single embedded REAL ClinicalTrials.gov study record NCT03898180 (top-level records.NCT03898180 of this instance file; fetched verbatim from the public v2 API, GET https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT03898180, no field edited or paraphrased -- see bench/artifacts/ctgov-NCT03898180/PROVENANCE), read exclusively via inspect_record(record_id='NCT03898180', field_path=...): protocolSection.designModule.studyType (interventional/observational classification), protocolSection.designModule.phases (trial phase), protocolSection.statusModule.overallStatus (recruitment/completion status), protocolSection.sponsorCollaboratorsModule.leadSponsor.name (lead sponsor identity), protocolSection.designModule.enrollmentInfo.count (enrollment count), and protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes (primary outcome text, background only). The verdict is scoped to this ONE record's own declared JSON fields only -- no network access, external registry cross-check, or human/LLM judgment is used or available; every atom below is a closed, mechanically-decidable Boolean predicate over the record (prime_runtime/predicates.py).

claims.text: The trial's study type is confirmed, from the record's own designModule field, to be INTERVENTIONAL (not observational).
The trial is confirmed interventional (C1) and its own declared phase (designModule.phases) is Phase 3.

The trial is confirmed interventional and Phase 3 (C2), its overall status is COMPLETED, its lead sponsor is Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC, and its enrollment count meets or exceeds 500 participants: the record supports a 'completed, adequately-powered Phase 3 pivotal trial sponsored by Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC' verdict.

atoms.proposition: The trial's study type is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT03898180', field_path='protocolSection.designModule.studyType') and found to equal 'INTERVENTIONAL'.
The trial's declared phase is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT03898180', field_path='protocolSection.designModule.phases.0') and found to be 'PHASE3'.
The trial's overall status is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT03898180', field_path='protocolSection.statusModule.overallStatus') and found to equal 'COMPLETED'.

The trial's lead sponsor name is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT03898180', field_path='protocolSection.sponsorCollaboratorsModule.leadSponsor.name') and found to be the named sponsor 'Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC'.
The trial's enrollment count is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT03898180', field_path='protocolSection.designModule.enrollmentInfo.count') and found to meet or exceed 500 participants.

Non-route background: the trial's primary outcome measure text is read via inspect_record(record_id='NCT03898180', field_path='protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes.0.measure') and found present (not required for, and not evidence toward, the interventional/Phase-3/completed/sponsor/enrollment verdict).

notes_for_annotators: REAL ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT03898180 (Study of First-line Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) With Lenvatinib (MK-7902/E7080) in Urothelial Carcinoma Cisplatin-ineligible Participants Whose Tumors Express Programmed Cell Death-Ligand 1 and in Participants Ineligible for Platinum-containing Chemotherapy (MK-7902-011/E7080-G000-317/ LEAP-011)), lead sponsor Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC -- retrieved live via the public v2 API on 2026-07-29 (bench/fetch_ctgov.py; full provenance in bench/artifacts/ctgov-NCT03898180/PROVENANCE, including the untouched raw API response record.json.raw alongside the embedded pruned record.json). Route minimality: E1 necessary (interventional status must be read before any claim -- an observational trial would make every stronger claim inapplicable); E2 necessary and DISJOINT from E1 (the phase field is a separate designModule key from studyType -- an interventional trial can be any phase, so E1 alone cannot establish 'Phase 3'); E3 necessary (overallStatus is disjoint from phase -- a Phase 3 trial can be RECRUITING/TERMINATED/etc., so E2 alone cannot establish 'completed'); E4 necessary (leadSponsor.name is disjoint from status -- a completed Phase 3 trial can have any sponsor, so C3's claim of a SPECIFIC named sponsor requires reading this field specifically); E5 necessary (enrollmentInfo.count is disjoint from all four other fields -- a completed, correctly-sponsored Phase 3 trial can still have under-target enrollment, so the 'adequately powered' component of C3's text requires this numeric threshold check specifically). Order-coherence by containment (C1's route subset of C2's, C2's subset of C3's). E6 (primaryOutcomes[0].measure) is a genuine non-route atom -- real, resolvable, on-topic-looking background (the trial's primary endpoint) deliberately NOT required by any route, probing whether an agent pulls in irrelevant-but-plausible evidence rather than staying scoped to the interventional/Phase-3/completed/sponsor/enrollment question, mirroring rec-0001's E5 and grant-0001's E5. Decoy external_registry_crosscheck is not a listed action (this domain deliberately offers no network/external-registry lookup tool -- everything needed is in the embedded record).
